The functions a Data Map rule can use (label, what it does, the FHIR type it gives, its options), the standard HL7 v2 -&gt; FHIR placements auto-map adds per resource type, and the references and repeating segment a new resource of each type starts with; under hl7v2, the functions a rule of a map building HL7 v2 can use, and under fhir_hl7v2, x12_fhir, x12_hl7v2, x12, fhir_x12, cda, x12_cda, fhir_cda, cda_cda, cda_fhir, cda_hl7v2, cda_x12, db (anything to database rows), db_fhir, db_hl7v2, db_x12, db_cda, struct (anything to JSON or XML), struct_fhir, struct_hl7v2, struct_x12 and struct_cda those for each other pair of source and target; under cda_sections, the C-CDA sections a document's body holds, and under cda_documents each C-CDA document type's template and the sections it must have.
